subject.title: Embedded runner: freshly streamed thinking signatures intermittently invalid on replay (Anthropic); recovery wrapper never fires because error text is genericized

question: Should this broad issue remain the canonical umbrella until Anthropic signed-thinking replay prevention lands, or should maintainers move the remaining work to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 / https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/94228 now that the recovery-carrier fixes are on main?
rationale: The recovery halves are implemented, but the remaining prevention path changes provider replay behavior and has multiple open candidate PRs with compatibility, auth-provider, and message-delivery tradeoffs.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Open
options.body: Leave this issue open as the broad production incident tracker until a chosen prevention PR lands or maintainers formally split the variants.

options.title: Make Narrow Issue Canonical
options.body: Close this issue as superseded only after posting a clear handoff to the narrower open issue and its candidate prevention PRs.

options.title: Defer Prevention Policy
options.body: Treat the landed recovery fixes as sufficient for now and leave prevention to a later provider replay design pass.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Open
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the broad production incident tracker until a chosen prevention PR lands or maintainers formally split the variants.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is already in the issue discussion and has recent current-main ownership signals on the affected files.
